text: A haemoglobin test measures the amount of haemoglobin in a blood sample.
label: what_it_measures
source_note: Stage 6.3 illustrative educational sentence created for this project.

text: A fasting glucose test measures the amount of glucose present in blood after a fasting period.
label: what_it_measures
source_note: Stage 6.3 illustrative educational sentence created for this project.

text: A platelet count measures the number of platelets in a blood sample.
label: what_it_measures
source_note: Stage 6.3 illustrative educational sentence created for this project.

text: A white blood cell count measures circulating white blood cells in a blood sample.
label: what_it_measures
source_note: Stage 6.3 illustrative educational sentence created for this project.

text: HbA1c provides an estimate of average blood glucose exposure over a preceding period.
label: what_it_measures
source_note: Stage 6.3 illustrative educational sentence created for this project.

text: Doctors may check haemoglobin to understand blood oxygen-carrying capacity.
label: why_doctors_check_it
source_note: Stage 6.3 illustrative educational sentence created for this project.

text: Doctors may check fasting glucose as part of an assessment of glucose control.
label: why_doctors_check_it
source_note: Stage 6.3 illustrative educational sentence created for this project.

text: Doctors may review platelet counts when they need information about blood clotting components.
label: why_doctors_check_it
source_note: Stage 6.3 illustrative educational sentence created for this project.

text: A white blood cell count may be checked when information about immune-cell levels is needed.
label: why_doctors_check_it
source_note: Stage 6.3 illustrative educational sentence created for this project.

text: A clinician may check HbA1c to assess longer-term patterns in glucose exposure.
label: why_doctors_check_it
source_note: Stage 6.3 illustrative educational sentence created for this project.

text: Low haemoglobin levels may be associated with lower red blood cell oxygen-carrying capacity and can sometimes prompt anaemia-related evaluation.
label: common_associations
source_note: Stage 6.3 illustrative educational sentence created for this project.

text: Higher-than-lab-range fasting glucose values may be associated with difficulty regulating blood glucose and may need clinical context.
label: common_associations
source_note: Stage 6.3 illustrative educational sentence created for this project.

text: A platelet count below the laboratory range may be associated with a higher likelihood of bruising or bleeding, although other factors and repeat testing may matter.
label: common_associations
source_note: Stage 6.3 illustrative educational sentence created for this project.

text: Elevated white blood cell counts may be associated with infection or inflammation, while several non-infectious factors can also influence them.
label: common_associations
source_note: Stage 6.3 illustrative educational sentence created for this project.

text: A higher HbA1c level may reflect increased average glucose exposure over recent months and is interpreted in clinical context.
label: common_associations
source_note: Stage 6.3 illustrative educational sentence created for this project.
